bio: A place steeped in history and full of charm – from the hotel's pretty, individually designed guestrooms to the restaurant, in which old wood panelling exudes cosiness. In a pleasant and lively atmosphere, they serve good classic cuisine in the form of dishes such as sea bass with a lemon and caper butter, or Geschnetzeltes Kalbsfilet Zürcher Art (veal strips in a mushroom and cream sauce). At lunchtime, check out the additional daily specials for a quick meal. Tip: Don't forget to make a reservation, as they always get booked up!...
